parameters.name: APIVersion
parameters.description: The identifier used for canary release evaluation.

parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: The OSS bucket filter.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The database name filter.

parameters.name: DomainId
parameters.description: The data domain ID to which the data asset belongs.

parameters.name: FacetType
parameters.description: The facet dimension for associated filtering in the data catalog. Valid values: rule (category), task (task), instance (instance), and db (database). If this parameter is not specified or is empty, the original list and count query is performed (behavior unchanged). If a valid value is specified, the list query is skipped and only content.hitValues is returned. If an invalid value is specified, a parameter error is returned.

parameters.name: FeatureType
parameters.description: **[Deprecated]** This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: FileCategoryCode
parameters.description: The file category code.

parameters.name: FileType
parameters.description:
The OSS file type supported for detection.

> You can call [DescribeDocTypes](~~2536492~~) to obtain the supported OSS file types. Use the Code field value from the response. This parameter is valid only for OSS asset queries.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The keyword of the asset instance ID.

parameters.name: IsRevision
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter revision items.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: LogStore
parameters.description: The SLS Logstore filter.

parameters.name: LogStoreFlag
parameters.description: The data catalog SLS page has two layers. This parameter indicates whether the query is at the Logstore dimension.

parameters.name: MemberAccount
parameters.description: The member accounts ID.

parameters.name: ModelIds
parameters.description:
The model IDs of the industry template, separated by commas.
> You can call [DescribeTemplateAllRules](~~2536491~~) to obtain the industry template model IDs.

parameters.name: ModelTagIds
parameters.description:
The data tags to query, separated by commas. Valid values:
- **101**: personal sensitive information.
- **102**: personal information.
- **107**: general information.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of data asset instances to return per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ParentCategoryIds
parameters.description: The list of parent category IDs of the templates to query, separated by commas.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The file path filter.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description: The product of the data catalog.

parameters.name: ProductIds
parameters.description:
We recommend that you specify this parameter. The list of product IDs to query, separated by commas. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute
- **2**: OSS
- **3**: ADB-MYSQL
- **4**: TableStore
- **5**: RDS
- **6**: SELF_DB
- **7**: PolarDB-X
- **8**: PolarDB
- **9**: ADB-PG
- **10**: OceanBase
- **11**: MongoDB
- **25**: Redis

> OSS is mutually exclusive with other products. If OSS is included in the query, no other products can be specified. By default, non-OSS products are queried.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The SLS project filter.

parameters.name: QueryName
parameters.description: The keyword of the data object to query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the data catalog display page.

parameters.name: RiskLevelIdList
parameters.description: The risk level filter.

parameters.name: RiskLevels
parameters.description:
The risk levels of the data assets to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,).
- **2**: S1, low risk level.
- **3**: S2, medium risk level.
- **4**: S3, high risk level.
- **5**: S4, highest risk level.

parameters.name: RuleIds
parameters.description: The rule filter.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the asset resides. Valid values:
- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing).
- **cn-zhangjiakou**: China (Zhangjiakou).
- **cn-huhehaote**: China (Hohhot).
- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou).
- **cn-shanghai**: China (Shanghai).
- **cn-shenzhen**: China (Shenzhen).
- **cn-hongkong**: Hong Kong (China).

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The task name filter.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID filter.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The industry template ID.

> You can call [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) to obtain the industry template ID.
